name: NRB Bearings Ltd
title: NRB Bearings Ltd - 530367 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 19.2% to INR370 crore and PAT up 15%, but management withdrew the INR2,500 crore FY31 aspiration toward ~INR2,700-3,000 crore and gave no numbers on FY27 international growth or capex.

triggers.label: FY31 aspiration INR2,500cr → ~2,700-3,000cr
triggers.quote: Is INR2,500 crores too low? Definitely it looks like lower than we're going to achieve, for sure.

triggers.label: Nominated business INR800cr → INR1,100cr
triggers.quote: So that alone has taken the INR800 crores to INR1,100 crores

triggers.label: Cost escalation offset by VAVE and price increases
triggers.quote: we have a combination of VAVE, which is, value engineering and cost reduction in the plants and price increases to deal with this.

triggers.label: Unitec JV capex INR110cr, commissioning April 2027

summary.headline: NRB Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 19.2% to INR370 crore and PAT 15% to INR38 crore; management reframed FY31 vision near INR2,700-3,000 crore.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue from operations reached INR370 crore vs INR310 crore a year earlier (+19.2%), and PAT rose to INR38 crore from INR33 crore (+15%). Standalone sales grew 14.7% YoY, standalone PAT 31.7% and standalone EBITDA 21.7%. Management used the call to lay out six adjacency vectors (aerospace via Mahant Tool Room/MTR, automotive adjacencies, electrification, new mobility, heavy off-highway, stationary industrial) and announced a General Motors Corvette planet-pin production order from NRB USA. Management declined to give formal guidance and reframed the FY31 target around the trailing 12-month growth rate.

financial_highlights.value: INR300 crore by 2031 with INR90 crore profit contribution
About INR30 crore including spherical bearing orders
financial_highlights.change: Acquisition closed about one month before call
Up from INR800 crore, driven by US Corvette win

segments.name: Automotive (core)
segments.commentary: Management cites EV-agnostic positioning with about 70% of content in chassis, transmission and steering applications common to EV, ICE and hybrid; BMW i steering launch planned for 2027.

segments.name: Industrial
segments.commentary: Industrial is 14% of revenue, up from 11%, with 34% growth; management tracks this only annually.

segments.name: Aerospace and defence (MTR / Mahant Tool Room)
segments.commentary: Acquired about a month before the call; INR300 crore revenue and INR90 crore profit contribution targeted by 2031; order book about INR30 crore including a Sukhoi-30 plain spherical bearing order developed with HAL Nashik.

segments.name: Non-aerospace defence and heavy mobility
segments.commentary: NRB is an accredited US defence supplier for heavy vehicle applications and supplies French and US defence programmes; about INR20 crore of order book in hand.

segments.name: Unitec JV (industrial cylindrical roller bearings)
segments.commentary: INR110 crore investment, INR130 crore capacity; plant to be commissioned by April 2027 at Shendra, Aurangabad (moved from Hyderabad), partly ready facility purchased.

guidance_outlook: No formal FY27 growth guidance; management said it is conservative and declined to confirm the 15-20% FY27 growth question directly.

FY31 target: trailing 12-month growth (about 14.3-14.4%) implies about INR2,730 crore by FY31; management said INR2,500 crore 'definitely' looks low and the vision is closer to INR3,000 crore, with new verticals as the upside.
Margin range stated at 18-20% over an annual period; management said it is not a quarterly-driven company.
Unitec JV plant commissioning targeted by April 2027.
Management said MTR order book will convert into FY27 revenue, but declined to quantify it.
Management said the company will announce more electrification-related business over the next three to six months.
Management intends to give nomination and guidance updates once a year, not quarterly.
capex_capacity: Total capex programme about INR270 crore; INR60 crore spent so far, a further INR100 crore ordered or in process, to be used within the current financial year (per management's answer).
Management said INR100 crore of capex supports about INR130 crore of sales.
Unitec JV: INR110 crore investment, INR130 crore capacity, commissioning by April 2027 at Aurangabad (Shendra); land and partly ready building already purchased.
NRB USA facility in Columbia, South Carolina: first win is a GM Corvette planet-pin production order (about 300,000 peak volume).
Data centre bearings are at product-development stage; no launch timing given.
demand_pricing: Other expenses rose about INR10 crore QoQ (versus a typical INR90-92 crore run rate) due to electricity, logistics and petroleum-linked cost escalation; offsets are value engineering (VAVE) and price increases.
Management cited logistics cost and a 'war situation' as reasons for relocating the Unitec JV from Hyderabad to Aurangabad.
Management said the Corvette win is a Make-in-USA business that was not part of earlier nominations; the GM program is open only to US bearing manufacturers.
Robotics, humanoids, AGVs, automation and data centres are being developed as new product areas; HAAS Automation order cited as an example of new-vertical wins.
SNL Bearings is a brand at a lower price point, serving price-sensitive replacement customers; management said it sometimes cannibalises NRB products.
Sukhoi-30 spherical bearing order and Mercedes/BMW transmission wins cited as high-margin, long-cycle programmes.

qa_highlights.question: Will FY27 growth continue at about 19%, closing 15-20%, and will FY31 guidance be raised from INR2,500 crore to INR3,000 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to guide FY27 but said trailing 12-month growth of 14.38% implies about INR2,730 crore by 2031; INR3,000 crore is the aspirational vision.

qa_highlights.question: Unitec JV location, capex and commissioning timeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Location moved from Hyderabad to Aurangabad; INR110 crore investment with INR130 crore capacity; commissioning by April 2027.

qa_highlights.question: Industrial share of revenue and path to 20-25%?
qa_highlights.answer: Industrial is 14% of revenue (up from 11%), growing 34%; tracked annually, not quarterly.

qa_highlights.question: Does EV give higher bearing content per vehicle than ICE?
qa_highlights.answer: No quantification; management said about 70% of NRB's applications are common across EV, ICE and hybrid, so the EV/ICE split does not drive its growth.

qa_highlights.question: Defence and aerospace order book, and FY27/FY31 contribution?
qa_highlights.answer: MTR order book about INR30 crore plus about INR20 crore non-aerospace defence (about INR50 crore total); MTR targets INR300 crore revenue and INR90 crore profit by 2031.

qa_highlights.question: Other expenses jumped about INR10 crore QoQ; what drove it?
qa_highlights.answer: Electricity, logistics and petroleum-linked cost escalation, offset by value engineering and price increases.

qa_highlights.question: Capex of about INR250 crore: how much spent and planned this year?
qa_highlights.answer: Total programme INR270 crore; INR60 crore spent, a further INR100 crore ordered or in process.

qa_highlights.question: Will margins return to above 20%, and was Mahant Tool's team retained?
qa_highlights.answer: Margins are guided to 18-20% annually; Mallappa leads the aerospace defence segment and the team has been retained.

qa_highlights.question: Has nominated business risen from INR800 crore, and will MTR contribute FY27 revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Nominated business is now INR1,100 crore after the Corvette win; MTR will convert order book into revenue in FY27, though no amount was given.

qa_highlights.question: Will SNL Bearings be merged into NRB?
qa_highlights.answer: No concrete plan to merge; SNL is seen as a strategic, growing, lower-priced brand with proprietary technology.

risks_watch: Guidance is qualitative and inconsistent: FY31 target moved from INR2,500 crore to around INR2,700-3,000 crore in the call; watch for a formal number.
Input cost pressure (power, logistics, petroleum-linked) and the one-quarter INR10 crore jump in other expenses; watch whether VAVE and price increases restore margins within the 18-20% range.
Aerospace/MTR revenue timing is unquantified; order book about INR30 crore; the 2031 targets depend on conversion.
Unitec JV commissioning by April 2027 and the INR100 crore of pending capex conversion to revenue.
Data centre and robotics product lines are still in development with no announced timeline.
Nominated business (INR1,100 crore) and the USD300,000 peak-volume figure were reconciled only on the call; management said it will update once a year.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the growth narrative and the new verticals, but conservative and deliberately evasive on numbers: it declined to give forward guidance, deferred several quantitative questions (MTR revenue timing, nominated business, data centre plans), and repeatedly pointed to annual updates.
key_quotes: Is INR2,500 crores too low? Definitely it looks like lower than we're going to achieve, for sure.
Manpower is a very small and insignificant part of this kind of business. It is really equipment and sheer infrastructure in terms of the quality of the space, and the quality of the supply chain.
I have repeatedly said that our margins are between 18% to 20%.

adds.what: Unitec JV industrial cylindrical roller bearings plant, INR130 crore capacity at Shendra, Aurangabad
Total capex programme ~INR270 crore; INR100 crore ordered or in process to be used within current FY (INR100 crore supports ~INR130 crore sales)
NRB USA facility (Columbia, South Carolina) GM Corvette planet-pin production order, ~300,000 peak volume

growth.why: No formal FY27 guidance; FY31 vision reframed off trailing ~14.3% growth (implying ~INR2,730 crore by FY31), with MTR order book (~INR30 crore) and INR20 crore defence order book as partial backing, and Unitec JV (INR130 crore capacity) due April 2027.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Margins guided at 18-20% annually, but other expenses rose about INR10 crore QoQ (vs INR90-92 crore run rate) on power, logistics and petroleum costs, with VAVE and price increases as offsets.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Unitec JV plant with INR130 crore capacity and INR110 crore investment is under construction at Shendra, Aurangabad, with commissioning targeted by April 2027; partly ready facility already purchased.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Trailing 12-month revenue growth is about 14.3-14.4%, Q1 consolidated revenue grew 19.2%, and MTR's INR30 crore order book is to convert into FY27 revenue, though unquantified.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: About INR270 crore total capex programme with INR60 crore spent and INR100 crore ordered or in process; management also said more electrification business will be announced in the next 3-6 months, though no new capex amount was given.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management declined to give formal FY27 guidance and said it updates nominations and guidance only once a year, so no near-term upgrade is signalled.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: No formal guidance exists, and management was evasive on the 15-20% FY27 growth question; input cost escalation could weigh on margins.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Data centre bearings are at product-development stage with no launch timing, robotics and AGVs are in development, and BMW i steering launch is planned for 2027; the Corvette planet-pin production order is approved.

rows.label: MTR aerospace order book converting to FY27 revenue
rows.why: About INR30 crore MTR order book, including a Sukhoi-30 spherical bearing order, is to convert into FY27 revenue, though management did not quantify it.

rows.label: GM Corvette planet-pin production order from NRB USA
rows.why: Approved Make-in-USA order at about 300,000 peak volume lifts lifetime nominated business to INR1,100 crore from INR800 crore.

rows.label: Price increases and value engineering to offset cost escalation
rows.why: Management cited price increases and VAVE as offsets to the INR10 crore QoQ jump in other expenses, which runs against a INR90-92 crore run rate.

tone.note: Management was confident on the growth narrative, new verticals and the Corvette win, but declined formal FY27 guidance and deferred quantitative questions on MTR revenue timing, nominated business and data centre plans; analysts pushed on FY27 growth, FY31 target and margins.
